passage: “What is the price for the box of white mice?” Grace asks. The man at the pet shop tells Grace they cost five bucks. “I have five bucks! I would like to take these mice,” says Grace. The man hands the box of mice to Grace.

Grace takes the mice home. Grace makes a track for the white mice. She wants them to race. Grace will place the mice on the track. When Grace says “GO!” the mice race. They run the track twice. “These mice are so fast!” says Grace.
